title: Default PES is version 6 with objects and a thread table
description: design.export without pesVersion writes PES version 6 with a CEmbOne/CSewSeg stitch group and the RGB thread table; 1t stays available as the smallest, machine-only file.

evidence.note: a minimal PES loads in PE-DESIGN as a blank document

pageMode custom (#1013): the reference is PE-DESIGN's re-save of its version 6 file as OpenStitch wrote it, and PE-DESIGN drops a zero-length stitch when it opens a stitch file. Round 12 (2026-11-13) re-saved today's Hoop Size export, which starts with the stitch in place, and the re-save starts on the landing without it (the coordinator's round 12 capture, not in the repo: pes-default-v6.pes; the spec's reference is unchanged, as its stitches are the same). So the spec's design stays on a Custom Size page, whose stream PE-DESIGN keeps as written.

references.make: Run `stitchtool compat --only pes-default-v6` and open target/compat/work/pes-default-v6/a.pes in PE-DESIGN 11 (two open polylines sewn as running stitch, run pitch 2.5 mm, run times 1: (20,20)–(60,20)–(60,50)–(20,50) mm in Red, then (30,30)–(50,30)–(50,40) mm in Black; no region, so the file does not change when region generation does). If it opens blank, do not add a file: write what you saw in the notes of docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md instead. If it opens with its stitches, save it unchanged as PES. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

machine.make: Copy target/compat/work/pes-default-v6/a.pes to a USB stick, load it on a Brother machine and sew it; record whether it loads, its colour changes and how it sews.

measurements.evidence: audit item 2: at least one CEmbOne

internal regression: the Brother chart colours Red and Black from the script, written as PE-DESIGN 11.50 writes chart colours in its own Ver.6.0 file (pe11 fixture r01-rect-v6: BROTHER EMBROIDERY number, the PEC index as name, brand EMBROIDERY, type 0x0A, empty chart; #375) and read back with the chart names
PE-DESIGN 11 opens a.pes with its stitches and colours
